recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大多數細胞是圓核、深藍色細胞質、染色質塊狀的紅血球前驅細胞（有核紅血球），數量明顯多於顆粒球系，表示骨髓/紅系比（M:E ratio）倒置。
features: Marked predominance of erythroid precursors over granulocytic cells (inverted M:E ratio)
Erythroid precursors at all stages: basophilic, polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts
Round central nuclei with coarse, clumped chromatin and deeply basophilic to gray-blue cytoplasm
Orderly erythroid maturation without obvious megaloblastic change or multinucleation
Few granulocytes (bands, segmented neutrophils) scattered among erythroid cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is highly cellular and shows a marked predominance of erythroid precursors, with a reversed myeloid-to-erythroid ratio. Erythroid maturation is orderly, with basophilic, polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts having round nuclei and condensed chromatin; significant megaloblastic change or dyserythropoiesis is not evident in this field. Granulocytic precursors are relatively few but maturing. Findings are consistent with erythroid hyperplasia, as seen in hemolysis, blood loss or recovery; correlation with reticulocyte count and hemolysis studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic erythroid precursors are larger with open, sieve-like chromatin showing nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, accompanied by giant metamyelocytes.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of immature proerythroblasts (≥80% erythroid, ≥30% proerythroblasts) with fine chromatin, nucleoli and vacuolated cytoplasm, often TP53 mutated.
MDS shows dyserythropoiesis such as nuclear budding, internuclear bridging, multinucleation and ring sideroblasts, with clonal abnormalities.
